register.labelZh: SET 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: set about 可以描述着手處理工作;set off 和 set out 可以描述出發;set in 則可以描述天氣或某種情況開始。；你可以用 set apart 表示某人與眾不同,用 set something against something 比較兩方面,也可以用 set somebody against somebody 描述有人挑動雙方互相反對。；set something off 可以描述警報或事件被觸發;set somebody off 則可以描述某人突然開始笑、哭或說話。；SET 片語動詞可以幫助你談論鐘錶、費用、旅程、設備、生意、預留的金錢和擺放好的物品。
register.summaryEn: Set about describes beginning a task, set off and set out describe beginning a journey, and set in describes weather or a condition beginning. You can use set apart to show that somebody is different, set something against something to compare two sides, and set somebody against somebody to describe people being made to oppose each other. Set something off can describe an alarm or event beginning. Set somebody off can describe a person suddenly laughing, crying or talking. The SET family can help you talk about clocks, costs, journeys, equipment, business, saved money and arranged objects.

benefits.titleZh: 使用 SET 描述不同類型的開始
benefits.titleEn: Use SET to describe different kinds of beginnings
benefits.zh: set about 可以描述着手處理工作;set off 和 set out 可以描述出發;set in 則可以描述天氣或某種情況開始。
benefits.en: Set about describes beginning a task, set off and set out describe beginning a journey, and set in describes weather or a condition beginning.

benefits.titleEn: Talk about differences, comparisons and conflict
benefits.zh: 你可以用 set apart 表示某人與眾不同,用 set something against something 比較兩方面,也可以用 set somebody against somebody 描述有人挑動雙方互相反對。
benefits.en: You can use set apart to show that somebody is different, set something against something to compare two sides, and set somebody against somebody to describe people being made to oppose each other.

benefits.zh: set something off 可以描述警報或事件被觸發;set somebody off 則可以描述某人突然開始笑、哭或說話。
benefits.en: Set something off can describe an alarm or event beginning. Set somebody off can describe a person suddenly laughing, crying or talking.
